audit.why: 50.52% over 776 games with diff EVEN, diffRating 6/10 and carryRating 7/10 is a fair read: a short Renekton window at levels 1-2 and a Kennen game afterwards. The prose ratings agree with the enum, so nothing to move.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every one of the seven rows disagreed with the packet chart and with the mirror: the page gave Renekton levels 2, 3, first item and two items, and called Level 1 'Skill'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart and the audited mirror both read Renekton / Skill / Kennen / Kennen / Kennen / Kennen / Kennen. The content whys[2..6] already describe Kennen winning those five stages, so the side tokens were simply inverted against the page's own text.
audit.corrected: All seven rows set in matched full/content pairs to Renekton / Skill / Kennen / Kennen / Kennen / Kennen / Kennen, ratings adjusted, and the four full-layer whys that claimed Renekton pressure past level 2 rewritten. whys[0] reworded so Level 1 reads as Renekton's, matching the corrected row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mark of the Storm — the mechanic that actually kills Renekton — is never explained, and the page treats Kennen as an armour-shred matchup.
audit.why: Riot's kit: the passive stuns after three ability hits, and Thundering Shuriken (Q), Electrical Surge (W) and Lightning Rush (E) each apply a Mark, so Q-W-E is a stun with no ultimate involved. Q falls to a 4s cooldown at rank 5. Electrical Surge applies on-hit and Lightning Rush grants attack speed on exit, so his damage scales with attack speed and MR, not armour, reads the trade.
audit.corrected: The triple-stun is stated in dontsFull[1].d, the Q cooldown in dontsFull[0].d, and the on-hit/attack-speed reason for MR in dosFull[1].d.

audit.why: Lightning Rush is 10/9/8/7/6s and the page already builds the trade window on it; phases[3].why now carries the number.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Kennen must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Lightning Rush is online and his poke rhythm starts. Your core pattern only lands inside its cooldown, so count it before you step.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Lightning Rush's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His poke rhythm settles: Q every 6s, W marks on autos, Rush to leave. Count the 10-to-6s Rush and commit only inside that window.

edits.before: Eclipse is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Lightning Rush's cooldown.
edits.after: His first AP item outpaces your Eclipse — shove and rotate instead of forcing a losing 1v1.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Kennen carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on he out-ranges and out-sustains you. Kennen carry threat 7/10 — flank, and never engage while Slicing Maelstrom is up.

edits.before: You have no dash at Level 1 and Kennen's Thundering Shuriken Q pokes for free — farm safely with Q range and let him waste his energy stacking W marks you cannot punish yet.
edits.after: Thundering Shuriken costs 60 energy at rank 1 and he has no lightning form yet — if he steps up to poke, your Fury autos and Q out-trade him outright at melee range.

edits.before: Bank 50 fury on the wave, slice onto Kennen when his answer is down, empowered-W stun + Q heal, and dice out clean.
edits.after: Electrical Surge applies on-hit and Lightning Rush leaves him with attack speed — Mercury's and MR beat armour here.

edits.before: That is Kennen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Thundering Shuriken falls to a 4s cooldown at rank 5 — every hit is a free Mark.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Three Marks of the Storm stun you — Q, W and E each add one.

notes: Unverified and deliberately left alone: the page asserts in three places (whys[2], spikes[0].text, wants.foe[1], mid) that Lightning Rush lets Kennen 'phase through' or 'ghost through' Renekton's W stun. Riot's text only says it lets him pass through UNITS and grants move speed on entry and attack speed on exit — there is no untargetability or CC-immunity in the description, and the kit carries no untargetable or spellShield flag. If that claim is false, the entire stated win condition ('W-stun him off his E') is built on a mechanic that does not exist. I did not edit it because the kit cannot settle it either way — see questionsForUser. suspectNames flagged 'Use Lightning Rush' in wants.foe[1]: false positive, correct name.
